_note: 3-digit 0.56-inch 7-segment display block (056SMG_3 style). Common-cathode scanned: shared segment bus (a-g, dp) + 3 digit-select commons (com0-com2). No colon — this is the console score display, not a clock. 11 terminals: 8 segments bottom, 3 commons top. Firmware multiplexes the three digits by cycling com0-com2. Engine decomposes into per-digit virtual LEDs for MNA segment current.
